purpose: Additional adversarial scope audit requested by parent; not an independent review of my own finding.
full_original_context: Re-read cover and all three authored pages of the four-page Bundestag PDF. The submission’s overall theme is technical/economic unfitness for accelerating hydrogen energy projects. The disputed sentence follows a complaint that Leipzig’s proposed hydrogen turbine has not even achieved a test run, and precedes a general lack-of-technical/economic-preconditions conclusion.
strongest_alternative: In this context an engineer might use industrial to mean proven industrial-scale routine service or market-ready utility deployment, rather than a turbine classified as industrial operating in a demonstration. That reading is possible and materially limits what the counterexample establishes. The Leipzig reference concerns a substantially larger utility application, so direct scale/economics equivalence must not be asserted.
evidence_against_restrictive_reading: The actual sentence is universal worldwide and unqualified as to routine service, commercial maturity, duration, scale or non-demonstration status. The preceding test-run criterion makes exclusion of all demonstrations less natural. The SGT-400 is expressly described as an industrial gas turbine by the manufacturer and the European Commission project record, and was physically operated with 100% hydrogen before the submission.
primary_corroboration: The 10 November 2023 Commission CORDIS HYFLEXPOWER record confirms the industrial turbine demonstration while saying scaling and commercialisation are further work. NEDO’s April 2018 verification report is a separate earlier operation, but should not be used to assert commercial maturity either. Both originals are archived.
assessment: Retain only the provisional mismatch with categorical absence of any industrial-turbine operation. Keep the demonstration-versus-routine-commercial caveat prominent in the case itself. This does not refute broader cost, hydrogen-supply, safety, scaling or utility-capacity arguments and does not prove the acceleration bill is justified. A technical specialist could resolve the ordinary industry-language scope more confidently.
cited_article_context_followup: The 26 March 2024 Correctiv article in author footnote 9 was independently read in full. Its categorical no-operation claim concerns the SGT-800 model installed at Leipzig. It does not assert absence of all industrial turbine-model operation. This narrows what the article supports and strengthens the benign implicit-model alternative, while the author’s next standalone universal sentence still lacks that qualifier. No Correctiv quotation is reproduced and its model-specific reporting is not alleged false.
